desc:
🤖 **BREAK APART: MECH BATTLES** 💥

BUILD IT. FIGHT IT. BREAK IT APART.

⚙️ **BUILD YOUR OWN MECH** — Customize your robot with powerful arms, mechanical claws, spinning saws, shields, weapons, armor, and more!

💥 **REAL PHYSICS DESTRUCTION** — Smash through armor, rip off limbs, shatter cockpits, and watch enemy mechs fall apart piece by piece!

🦾 **CONTROL EVERY MOVE** — Experience physics-based combat with optional mouse-controlled arms. Grab, punch, block, and throw your way to victory!

⚔️ **BATTLE OTHER PLAYERS** — Fight in intense 1v1 duels, team up in 2v2 battles, or practice against AI opponents!

🏭 **EXPLORE MASSIVE ARENAS** — Battle across industrial factories, scrapyards, shipyards, and more!

🔧 **UNLOCK & UPGRADE** — Earn credits, unlock new mechs, collect powerful parts, and create the ultimate fighting machine!

🔥 **EVERY PART MATTERS. EVERY HIT COUNTS. NO TWO BATTLES ARE THE SAME.**

Do you have what it takes to build the ultimate mech?
